judged_text: Both computed keys in `minimumTokenResponseSchema` evaluate to the same string "[object Object]" (Zod schemas do not override toString) and collide — the second silently overwrites the first — so the schema enforces nothing beyond `access_token` and z.object strips every other field from the parsed output. In sharing mode the parsed data contains only `access_token`: the `expiry_date`/`expires_in` values the sync endpoint returns are dropped (Office365CalendarService persists a stale expiry and re-refreshes on every call or trusts an expired token; Zoom/office365video lose the expiry entirely), and the documented "any numeric property is the expiry" validation never runs, so a misconfigured parent endpoint silently poisons stored credentials instead of being rejected.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` attempts to express “any numeric property is the expiry” via computed keys: `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional()`. In a JS object literal these become fixed string property names (whatever `toString()` returns), not a wildcard/index signature, so they will not match real token fields like `expiry_date` / `expires_in`. Since Zod objects strip unknown keys by default, in sharing mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`) the safeParse result’s `.data` will retain essentially only `access_token` (and possibly those fixed-name keys if present), dropping expiry fields. The diff shows this return value is then used to update credentials (e.g., Office365 uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and spreads `tokenResponse.data`), so expiry can be lost/stale as the finding describes. The specific claim that both computed keys evaluate to the same string and collide is not strictly verifiable from the diff alone, but the underlying schema logic is clearly incorrect and causes the described data loss/behavior.
